jo (devex): Heads-up RFC incoming: standardize env var precedence across CLI + SDKs + sample apps. Want quick thumbs before I draft formal spec. TL;DR: single canonical priority, explicit whitelist of env names, and a `rw migrate-keys` helper for customers.

sam (sdk): Love the migrate helper idea. Curious what the exact precedence is you want. Also we should list exact var names so SDK parsers don't guess.

jo (devex): Proposed precedence (highest -> lowest):
1) REDWOOD_TOKEN (short-lived bearer)
2) REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY (scoped service key)
3) REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT + REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN pair
4) RW_API_KEY (deprecated fallback, warn)
If multiple present, SDK picks highest and logs source when REDWOOD_AUTH_DEBUG=1.

tess (cli): Implementation note: CLI will prefer REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY if present (non-interactive) and otherwise run interactive `rw login` to populate REDWOOD_TOKEN. `rw login --service` will create scoped service keys for infra use.

liam (security): Require service keys to include a `scope` claim and `kid` for rotation. Also enforce audience `aud: "redwood:ingest"` for embedding/sync keys. We need to add auditing for `service_key.create` events.

sam (sdk): Cross-language nuance: Go and Rust SDKs sometimes read ENV via different case-sensitivity on Windows. Let's add deterministic normalization: env var names are case-sensitive and canonical uppercase only. Document that in all SDK READMEs.

jo (devex): Good catch. Also plan for telemetry: SDK should emit a one-line non-sensitive telemetry event when a deprecated variable (RW_API_KEY) is used so we can track migration progress. No secret value shipped.

migrations-bot: Reminder: migration window for org-77 starts in 45 days. See https://console.redwood.ai/migrations/org-77

tess (cli): UX detail: `rw migrate-keys --from RW_API_KEY --to REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY --project proj-123` will call the Console API and create a scoped service key, print curl and env export snippets for CI. Add `--dry-run` to preview.

sam (sdk): Tests: add `auth_priority.test` matrix across env combinations, make sure `REDWOOD_AUTH_DEBUG` prints source but never token. Also test `from_env().source` metadata populated.

liam (security): Rotation policy: default TTL for service keys = 90d, max 1y. Recommend 30d rotation cadence. Also require HSM-backed keys for enterprise plan.

jo (devex): For sample apps: include `sample-app/.env.example` showing `# dev: REDWOOD_TOKEN` and `# ci: REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY`. We'll add `scripts/obtain_dev_token.sh` that uses a short-lived token creation endpoint and prints `export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...`.

sam (sdk): One bug to avoid: current Python SDK falls back to credential helpers if env contains `*_TOKEN` generically. We'll tighten to explicit names only.

tess (cli): Logging: CLI will emit `cli.auth.source=<env|file|interactive>` to internal logs (no secret). Also include `expires_at` in `~/.redwood/credentials` when token written.

liam (security): Make sure ephemeral tokens have `nbf`/`exp` and a `nonce` tied to the browser session to avoid replay when copied between machines.

jo (devex): Migration timeline suggestion: warnings start immediately; `rw migrate-keys` available in 30d; enforcement (error on RW_API_KEY only) in 180d. Will coordinate legal/compliance.

sam (sdk): OK, I'll draft SDK changes and PRs. We'll add matrix CI tests for Windows env case sensitivity.

tess (cli): I'll add the migrate command + lint rule `cli:deprecated-auth-env` that surfaces actionable message.

liam (security): Will write policy for service key issuance and rotation and review RFC.

jo (devex): Great, I'll open the RFC and include examples for CI, sample apps, and the migrate tool. Ping me if you want to pair on wording. :white_check_mark:
